request: Recheck whether any part of the simplified rental shopping flow was missed.

fixed.finding: A removed linked offer could silently fall back to another rental option.
fixed.change: Show an unavailable-link correction and require explicit selection of an available option before booking.
fixed.regression: RentalOffer.test.jsx: removed linked offer cannot silently book another size

fixed.finding: Return collection and extension were visible before pickup, although the backend only accepts them for an OUT rental.
fixed.change: Offer reschedule/cancel before pickup, collection/extension while OUT, and dispute where supported. Hide repeated pending cancellation and obsolete request forms.
fixed.regression: MyRentals.test.jsx: request choices follow the actual booking stage

fixed.finding: The optional customer calendar displayed a custody-duration quote as charged rental days.
fixed.change: Use the customer calendar for complete custody-period availability. Show final rent only after actual use days are selected at checkout. Staff calendar pricing remains available.
fixed.regression: RentalPricingCalendar.test.jsx: customer calendar omits custody-based charged duration and prices

fixed.finding: Admin rescheduling did not expose the newly introduced actual use dates.
fixed.change: Show and submit explicitly agreed use dates for USE_DAYS bookings. Server still checks availability and requires the new total to be explicitly accepted.
fixed.regression: Rentals.test.jsx and rentalShopping.integration.test.js: revised use dates, free transit and fresh price acceptance

earlierBackendAggregate.scope: Previous full grouped rental checks; backend production code unchanged during this follow-up.

browser.flow: Rental collection, product, availability calendar, bag, checkout, pickup booking, invoice use days and cancellation request.

remaining.deploy: Frontend and canonical backend/ need deployment.
remaining.liveAcceptance: Real OTP, managed licence, payment capture/webhook/refund, store inventory and physical pickup/return remain deployment acceptance checks.
remaining.claim: This review covers identified requirements and tested edge cases; it is not a guarantee that no future issue can occur.
